\[
I_{\text{out}} = 255 - I
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(I\): Input value from 0 to 255

The image negative of Gonzalez and Woods, with L - 1 = 255. Each value is mirrored around the middle of the range. With RGB scope every color turns into its complement. With the brightness scope only luma is mirrored, so hues stay and light and dark swap.
